# Docs index

One line per page: what it answers and when to read it. Read this page, then only the page your task needs. The big pages (`puppet.md`, `dungeons-boss.md`, `native-puppets.md`, `objects.md`, `game-ui.md`, `playtest.md`, `testing.md`) are long: search them (`grep -n`) and read the range you need.

**Look an address up before you search for it.** [addresses.md](addresses.md) lists every game address and offset the code names (constant, value, file and line, the code's own comment). It is generated by `tools/address_index.py`; the code stays the source. Offsets that are not constants (a struct layout, a chain of pointers) are in the area doc of the thing they belong to, listed below. The offsets of the main module belong to one game build: [game-builds.md](game-builds.md).

## Start here

| Page | Answers | Read when |
|---|---|---|
| [plan.md](plan.md) | The stages (emulator first, then the native recomp) and where each stands | You need the direction or want to know whether a feature is planned |
| [agent-state.md](agent-state.md) | What is done, open and waited on, without personal data | You start work and want the current picture |
| [agent-handoff.md](agent-handoff.md) | What the test-kit work learned: actor and component offsets, game behaviour found in runs, how we test, what we ask the maintainer's agent | You work on objects, bosses or dungeons, or on a handoff between agents |
| [known-issues.md](known-issues.md) | What works and what players still see broken in the newest release | A report might already be known; you change behaviour players see |
| [sync-coverage.md](sync-coverage.md) | Per actor class: is it shared between games, by which path, is it proven | A desync report; before you add or change a shared thing |
| [workflow.md](workflow.md) | How the AI sessions that build co-op are organised (roles, briefs, reports) | You need to know who does what |

## Facts that several pages mention: where each is kept

Each of these is written in full in one place; the other pages only name it. Use the one place.

| Fact | Kept in |
|---|---|
| Moving an actor: the set-matrix call (`main+0x4c6580`, vtable slot `0x218`), why a plain write is undone, the physics bit | [agent-handoff.md](agent-handoff.md) section 1; the reasoning and tests in [objects.md](objects.md) ("Moving an actor needs the game's own setter") |
| Our Link's input-off check (`main+0x3025850`, Hookshot wrap 18) | [native-puppets.md](native-puppets.md), with the first finding in [native-player.md](native-player.md) |
| The AI hold (`blr x8` at `main+0x369df8`, the cave and table) | [objects.md](objects.md) ("The hold"); the patch in [hookshot.md](hookshot.md) |
| The counter hook (`main+0x5e6760`) and the cave's ring | [objects.md](objects.md) (counters table) |
| Free code space at the end of `main` (`0x3c46280` to `0x3c47000`) and who uses which part | [puppet.md](puppet.md) ("Code in the padding") |
| Converting a game address (`0x83426710`) to a `main+` offset, and the study tools | [game-study.md](game-study.md) |
| The title screen's class, button count and layout | [hookshot.md](hookshot.md) (how it is found), [game-ui.md](game-ui.md) (the UI system) |
| Every constant's value and the comment the code gives it | [addresses.md](addresses.md) |
